requirement: The ISBN field must be a 13-digit ISBN-13; other formats are rejected.
label: GAP
reasoning: There is no code anywhere in the service that validates the ISBN field format. The create_book and update_book routes only check that ISBN is a string (via validate_string_field and isinstance checks), but never verify that it is exactly 13 digits or conforms to ISBN-13 format. A test submitting an invalid ISBN (e.g., '123' or a 10-digit ISBN) would be accepted without error.
